name: IVX CI

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      testTarget:
        description: Backend test files or directories to run
        required: false
        default: default
      buildApk:
        description: Also build the Android release APK (set to "true")
        required: false
        default: "false"
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "backend/**"
      - "expo/app.config.ts"
      - "expo/android/app/build.gradle"
      - "expo/ivxholding-landing/index.html"
      - "expo/scripts/verify-apk-release-consistency.mjs"
      - "expo/src/modules/chat/services/chatMessageUtils.ts"
      - "expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/**"
      - "expo/__tests__/**"
      - "bun.lock"
      - ".github/workflows/ivx-ci.yml"
      - "backend/tsconfig.json"

jobs:
  backend-tests:
    name: Backend tests (bun)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.9
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install
      - name: Run env-independent backend tests
        run: |
          TARGET="${{ github.event.inputs.testTarget || 'default' }}"
          if [ "$TARGET" = "default" ] || [ "$TARGET" = "all" ]; then
            echo "Running full backend test suite (env-independent files)..."
            bun test \
              backend/ivx-registration-orchestrator.test.ts \
              backend/ivx-timezone.test.ts \
              backend/ivx-senior-developer-capabilities.test.ts \
              backend/ivx-ci-build-runner.test.ts \
              backend/ivx-growth-autonomous-ops.test.ts \
              backend/services/ivx-agent-certification.test.ts \
              backend/services/ivx-owner-ai-intent-router.test.ts
          else
            echo "Running targeted tests: $TARGET"
            bun test $TARGET
          fi

  chat-tests:
    name: Chat + intent + performance tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.9
      - name: Install expo dependencies
        run: cd expo && bun install
      - name: Run intent classifier tests
        run: cd expo && bun test src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxOwnerIntentClassifier.test.ts
      - name: Run chat performance optimizer tests
        run: cd expo && bun test src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxChatPerformanceOptimizer.test.ts
      - name: Test canonical chat ordering
        run: cd expo && bun test __tests__/chat-canonical-order.test.ts

  release-consistency:
    name: Android release consistency
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.9
      - name: Validate configured APK release references
        run: node expo/scripts/verify-apk-release-consistency.mjs
      - name: Install Expo dependencies
        run: cd expo && bun install

  secret-scan:
    name: Secret scan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.9
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install
      - name: Scan for leaked secrets
        run: |
          # Check for common secret patterns in source files (not .env.example)
          EXIT_CODE=0
          for pattern in 'ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}' 'github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{82}' 'sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{48}' 'rnd_[A-Za-z0-9]{24}' 'sbp_[a-z0-9]{40}'; do
            FOUND=$(grep -r --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' --include='*.js' --include='*.mjs' \
              --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git --exclude='*.test.ts' \
              --exclude='.env.example' --exclude='.env.production.template' \
              -E "$pattern" . 2>/dev/null || true)
            if [ -n "$FOUND" ]; then
              echo "SECRET LEAK DETECTED (pattern: $pattern):"
              echo "$FOUND"
              EXIT_CODE=1
            fi
          done
          if [ $EXIT_CODE -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "No secrets detected in source files."
          fi
          exit $EXIT_CODE

  android-apk:
    name: Android release APK
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.buildApk == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.9
      - name: Setup Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "17"
      - name: Setup Android SDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
        with:
          packages: 'platform-tools platforms;android-35 build-tools;35.0.0'
      - name: Install root dependencies
        run: bun install
      - name: Install expo dependencies
        run: cd expo && bun install
      - name: Build release APK
        id: build
        run: |
          cd expo/android
          set -o pipefail
          ./gradlew assembleRelease --no-daemon -x lint 2>&1 | tee gradle-build.log
          GRADLE_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
          echo "build_exit=$GRADLE_EXIT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          if [ "$GRADLE_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::Gradle build failed (exit $GRADLE_EXIT)"
            echo "### Gradle build failure — last 400 lines" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            tail -400 gradle-build.log >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          JAVA_HOME: ${{ env.JAVA_HOME }}
          ANDROID_HOME: ${{ env.ANDROID_SDK_ROOT }}
      - name: Upload build log on failure
        if: always() && steps.build.outcome != 'success'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ivx-android-release-build-log-${{ github.sha }}
          path: expo/android/gradle-build.log
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Record APK SHA-256
        if: steps.build.outcome == 'success'
        run: sha256sum expo/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk
      - name: Upload APK artifact
        if: steps.build.outcome == 'success'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ivx-holdings-apk
          path: expo/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk

      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:

Let me take a step back and assess the full situation carefully. I've been stuck in a loop trying to deploy fix branches to Render, and they keep failing with `update_failed`. The root issue is that the `runGithubMergePullRequest` function has a bug where it passes an integer `number` to `runGithubPullRequestStatus` which expects a string via `readTrimmed`.

Let me re-read the code carefully:

```typescript
async function runGithubMergePullRequest(input: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  const repoInfo = await getGithubRepoInfo(input);
  const number = Number.parseInt(readTrimmed(input.number ?? input.pullNumber), 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(number) || number <= 0) {
    throw new Error('A valid pull request number is required.');
  }
  ...
  const status = await runGithubPullRequestStatus({ ...input, number });
```

So `number` is parsed as an integer. Then `{ ...input, number }` overwrites the string `number` from `input` with the integer. Then `runGithubPullRequestStatus` does:

```typescript
const number = Number.parseInt(readTrimmed(input.number ?? input.pullNumber), 10);
```

`readTrimmed` does:
```typescript
function readTrimmed(value: unknown): string {
  return typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : '';
}
```

So if `number` is an integer (not a string), `readTrimmed(input.number)` returns `''`, then it falls through to `input.pullNumber`. If `input.pullNumber` is also not set (because the spread overwrote it), it also returns `''`. Then `Number.parseInt('', 10)` returns `NaN`, and the guard fails.

Wait, but I tried passing `pullNumber: '32'` and it still failed. Let me think about why...

The spread `{ ...input, number }` spreads ALL of input first, then sets `number`. So if I pass `input = { number: '32', pullNumber: '32', ... }`, the spread creates `{ number: '32', pullNumber: '32', ..., number: 32 }`. The integer `number: 32` overwrites the string `number: '32'`. But `pullNumber: '32'` survives!

So `runGithubPullRequestStatus` receives `{ number: 32, pullNumber: '32', ... }`. Then `readTrimmed(input.number)` returns `''` (because 32 is not a string), then `readTrimmed(input.pullNumber)` should return `'32'`. Then `Number.parseInt('32', 10)` returns 32. So it should work!

But the error says "A valid pull request number is required." — which means `Number.parseInt` returned NaN or <= 0. Let me check if maybe the issue is that `pullNumber` is also being converted...

Actually wait, let me re-read the `runGithubMergePullRequest` code again:

```typescript
const number = Number.parseInt(readTrimmed(input.number ?? input.pullNumber), 10);
if (!Number.isFinite(number) || number <= 0) {

Then:

```

This spreads `input` (which has `number: '32'` and `pullNumber: '32'`) and then overwrites `number` with the integer 32. So the status call receives `{ number: 32, pullNumber: '32' }`.

In `runGithubPullRequestStatus`:
```typescript
const number = Number.parseInt(readTrimmed(input.number ?? input.pullNumber), 10);
```

`input.number` is 32 (integer, not string). `readTrimmed(32)` returns `''` (because it's not a string). Then `'' ?? input.pullNumber` — wait, `??` is the nullish coalescing operator. `''` is NOT null or undefined, so `'' ?? input.pullNumber` returns `''`, NOT `input.pullNumber`!

The fix is to change `??` to `||` in `runGithubPullRequestStatus`, OR to pass the number as a string in the merge function.
